papers.title: Parity-driven RKKY decoupling and anomalous $1/R$ Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction in $p$-wave magnets
papers.abstract: Unconventional $p$-wave magnets, characterized by an odd-parity momentum-dependent spin splitting, offer a fundamentally distinct paradigm for non-collinear spintronics. Here, we theoretically investigate the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida indirect exchange in a two-dimensional $p$-wave magnet subjected to Rashba spin-orbit coupling. Using an analytical real-space Green's function formalism, we uncover a parity-driven spatial decoupling in the magnetic response. Because of the odd-parity exchange field, the out-of-plane Ising interaction is structurally insulated from the macroscopic $p$-wave modulation, oscillating isotropically at the shifted Fermi wavevector. Conversely, the in-plane Heisenberg components exhibit pronounced, directionally tunable spatial beating. Beyond collinear exchange, the hybridized bands generate a highly tunable, three-component Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction alongside symmetric off-diagonal anisotropies. We reveal that the out-of-plane chiral twisting is driven by the massive, nonrelativistic $p$-wave momentum shift, while the in-plane chiral components are strictly relativistic. Furthermore, the competition between the $p$-wave nodal geometry and the Rashba gap drives an anomalous, dimension-reducing crossover, in which the in-plane chiral components follow a 1D-like $1/R$ spatial decay along the nodal lines over an extended intermediate-distance window before ultimately recovering the conventional 2D $1/R^2$ asymptote. These findings establish $p$-wave magnets as promising platforms for engineering robust, directionally tunable non-collinear spin textures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。依据关键词：theoretically investigate, analytical real-space Green‘s function formalism。；研究对象：二维p波磁体中的Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) 间接交换相互作用，以及Rashba自旋轨道耦合对其的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了p波磁体中由奇宇称性驱动的RKKY相互作用空间解耦现象，并发现了一种沿节线方向、在中间距离窗口内表现为一维$1/R$衰减的反常Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了p波磁体中由奇宇称性驱动的RKKY相互作用空间解耦现象，并发现了一种沿节线方向、在中间距离窗口内表现为一维$1/R$衰减的反常Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用。；创新点：首次在p波磁体背景下，系统研究了奇宇称交换场对RKKY相互作用各向异性（面外Ising与面内Heisenberg分量）以及Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用空间行为（包括反常的维度降低交叉）的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析实空间格林函数形式，对二维p波磁体在Rashba自旋轨道耦合下的RKKY相互作用进行了理论计算和分析。

papers.title: Soft point-contact Andreev reflection spectroscopy in a palm-type cubic anvil-pressure cell
papers.abstract: We have implemented soft point-contact Andreev reflection spectroscopy (PCARS) in a palm-type cubic anvil pressure cell by combining a substrate anchoring strategy with an external wire-splitting technique. This design enables the stable formation of multiple point contact junctions under hydrostatic pressures up to 15 GPa. Benchmark measurements on the elemental superconductor Nb demonstrate high reproducibility and yield a zero-temperature superconducting gap with a gap ratio of 3.3. We further apply this technique to the Kagome metal superconductor CsCr3Sb5 and the bilayer nickelate superconductor La2PrNi2O7. Pronounced zero-bias conductance peaks are observed, and their evolution with temperature, magnetic field and applied pressure is investigated, together with the superconducting gap magnitude and possible pairing symmetries. These measurements provide spectroscopic evidence consistent with unconventional superconductivity in these materials. Our work establishes a robust experimental platform that bridges macroscopic electrical transport and microscopic spectroscopic probes, opening a new avenue for investigating pairing symmetry in a wide range of pressure-induced unconventional superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了实验技术实现（soft point-contact Andreev reflection spectroscopy）、装置设计（substrate anchoring strategy, external wire-splitting technique）以及对多种超导体的测量结果。；研究对象：压力诱导非常规超导体，具体包括：元素超导体Nb（作为基准测试）、Kagome金属超导体CsCr₃Sb₅、以及双层镍酸盐超导体La₂PrNi₂O₇。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高达15 GPa的静水压下成功实现了稳定的软点接触安德烈夫反射谱测量，并在CsCr₃Sb₅和La₂PrNi₂O₇中观测到显著的零偏压电导峰，其随温度、磁场和压力的演化提供了支持这些材料中非常规超导配对对称性的谱学证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高达15 GPa的静水压下成功实现了稳定的软点接触安德烈夫反射谱测量，并在CsCr₃Sb₅和La₂PrNi₂O₇中观测到显著的零偏压电导峰，其随温度、磁场和压力的演化提供了支持这些材料中非常规超导配对对称性的谱学证据。；创新点：首次在掌型立方顶压装置中实现了软点接触安德烈夫反射谱技术，将压力范围扩展至15 GPa，并成功应用于多种压力诱导非常规超导体，建立了连接宏观电输运与微观谱学探测的实验平台。
papers.method_zh: 软点接触安德烈夫反射谱（soft point-contact Andreev reflection spectroscopy, PCARS），结合基底锚定策略（substrate anchoring strategy）与外部引线分裂技术（external wire-splitting technique），在掌型立方顶压装置（palm-type cubic anvil pressure cell）中实现。

papers.title: Transport in magnetic-topological-insulator nanoribbons containing multiple superconductor-proximitized sectors
papers.abstract: Transport in devices with multiple proximitized sectors depends heavily on the complex phases of the pairing gaps of those sectors. We investigate magnetic topological insulator nanoribbons in two- and three-terminal setups with proximitized sectors and asymptotic normal leads. Our focus is on the regime of single chiral Majoranas. The characteristic electric and thermal interferometries of chiral Majoranas can be controlled by the complex phases of the pairing. We predict an AC Majorana effect, in which phase dynamics induced by a voltage bias generate measurable time-dependent conductance oscillations. A three-terminal junction with superconducting islands can be used as a Majorana router when the relative complex phases are configured.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We investigate”、“We predict”等理论推导和预言性表述，未提及任何实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：磁性拓扑绝缘体纳米带，其中包含多个超导近邻化区域。具体研究了两端和三端器件中的输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预言了手征马约拉纳费米子的一种交流效应：由电压偏置引起的配对相位动力学可产生可测量的时变电导振荡。此外，通过配置超导岛的相对复相位，可将三端结用作马约拉纳路由器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预言了手征马约拉纳费米子的一种交流效应：由电压偏置引起的配对相位动力学可产生可测量的时变电导振荡。此外，通过配置超导岛的相对复相位，可将三端结用作马约拉纳路由器。；创新点：揭示了通过调控多个超导近邻化区域的配对复相位，可以控制手征马约拉纳费米子的特征电学和热学干涉，并首次预言了由电压偏置驱动的交流马约拉纳效应。

papers.title: Enhanced diffusion of colloidal tracers due to enzymatic activity
papers.abstract: Enzymatic catalysis can generate nonequilibrium fluctuations, but how these couple to tracer motion at larger length scales depends on physical context. Here, we investigate colloidal tracers in two configurations: passive particles dispersed in an enzymatically active solution, and enzyme-decorated particles where catalysis occurs directly at the tracer surface. We combine differential dynamic microscopy (DDM), which probes ensemble-averaged long-time diffusion, with optical tweezer (OT) measurements of short-time force fluctuations, and compare several complementary metrics for quantifying activity-induced enhancement. For 1 $μ$m tracers, we observe activity-induced enhancements in both configurations, with the strongest effects for enzyme-decorated particles, which exhibit enhanced diffusion and increased non-thermal force fluctuations. For 200 nm tracers, enhancements are more subtle and method-dependent: DDM detects modest increases in diffusion for bare particles, while corresponding signatures are not resolved by the OT. These results demonstrate that enzymatic activity can be transduced from molecular to microscale motion and forces, but that the apparent magnitude and detectability of enhancement depend strongly on tracer size, localization of activity, the timescales probed by the measurement, and the metric used to quantify enhancement. More broadly, understanding how enzyme activity modifies transport and fluctuations across scales is important for interpreting nonequilibrium dynamics in active soft matter, intracellular transport, and chemically crowded biological environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了结合“差分动态显微镜（DDM）”和“光镊（OT）”两种实验技术进行测量。；研究对象：胶体示踪粒子在酶促反应驱动的非平衡环境中的扩散行为。具体研究了两种构型：1）被动粒子分散在酶活性溶液中；2）酶修饰粒子（催化反应直接在示踪粒子表面发生）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 酶促活性可以增强胶体示踪粒子的扩散和力涨落，但增强效应的幅度和可探测性强烈依赖于示踪粒子尺寸、活性位点的局域化程度、测量的时间尺度以及用于量化增强的指标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：酶促活性可以增强胶体示踪粒子的扩散和力涨落，但增强效应的幅度和可探测性强烈依赖于示踪粒子尺寸、活性位点的局域化程度、测量的时间尺度以及用于量化增强的指标。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作系统地比较了两种不同构型（溶液活性 vs. 表面活性）和两种不同尺寸（1 μm vs. 200 nm）的示踪粒子，并使用了互补的测量手段（长时扩散 vs. 短时力涨落）来全面表征酶活性诱导的增强效应，揭示了该效应的多尺度依赖性和测量方法敏感性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上结合了两种技术：1）差分动态显微镜（DDM），用于探测系综平均的长时扩散；2）光镊（OT），用于测量短时力涨落。同时比较了多种用于量化活性诱导增强的互补指标。

papers.title: Nonlinear Tellegen limit
papers.abstract: The Tellegen limit is the fundamental electromagnetic stability bound on magnetoelectric media. We show that nonlinear magnetoelectric coupling gives rise to a new Tellegen limit, which we term the nonlinear Tellegen limit. Unlike the linear Tellegen limit, which is fixed by material parameters, the nonlinear Tellegen limit is field-tunable -- a static electric or magnetic field drives the system toward electromagnetic instability at a material-specific critical field determined by the magnetic point group symmetry. The approach to this limit is accompanied by a field-tunable Faraday rotation that grows linearly with the applied field and is bounded from above by a universal maximum set by the nonlinear Tellegen limit -- beyond which the medium becomes electromagnetically unstable. We demonstrate the nonlinear Tellegen limit and the field-space stability phase diagram in two magnetically ordered material systems -- a d-wave altermagnet and an M-type hexagonal ferrite -- showing that the symmetry of the magnetic point group governs both the structure of the nonlinear magnetoelectric tensor and the resulting electromagnetic instability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中主要进行理论推导（如“show that nonlinear magnetoelectric coupling gives rise to a new Tellegen limit”），并基于对称性分析（magnetic point group symmetry）和相图构建（field-space stability phase diagram），未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：磁电介质中的非线性磁电耦合效应，具体研究两种磁有序材料体系：d波交变磁体（d-wave altermagnet）和M型六角铁氧体（M-type hexagonal ferrite）中的电磁稳定性边界。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种新的非线性Tellegen极限，该极限可通过外加静电场或静磁场进行调控，并伴随场可调的Faraday旋转；当外加场达到由磁点群对称性决定的临界值时，介质将发生电磁不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种新的非线性Tellegen极限，该极限可通过外加静电场或静磁场进行调控，并伴随场可调的Faraday旋转；当外加场达到由磁点群对称性决定的临界值时，介质将发生电磁不稳定性。；创新点：首次提出非线性Tellegen极限的概念，揭示了非线性磁电耦合导致的场可调电磁稳定性边界，并指出该极限对应的Faraday旋转存在由非线性Tellegen极限设定的普适上限。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于磁电介质的非线性磁电耦合张量结构，结合磁点群对称性约束，推导非线性Tellegen极限的表达式；通过构建场空间稳定性相图，分析两种具体材料体系（d波交变磁体与M型六角铁氧体）中的电磁不稳定性行为。

papers.title: Spectral-Domain Deep Learning of Intrinsic Scattering Operators for Arbitrarily Shaped Compact 3D Particles
papers.abstract: Rapid prediction of optical scattering from arbitrarily shaped three-dimensional particles is important for particle optics and photonic characterization, but remains challenging because of the large variability of complex morphologies and the strong angular dependence of their scattering responses. To address both issues, a dual spectral-domain neural scattering model is introduced in which morphology and scattering are represented in physically ordered bases: particle geometry is compressed into only 256 spherical-harmonic coefficients, and the optical response is encoded by the complex T-matrix in a spherical-vector-wave basis. The morphology spectrum replaces high-dimensional Euclidean geometry representations, such as voxel grids, point clouds, or meshes, with a compact ordered descriptor, while the T-matrix represents a geometry-determined scattering operator that can be queried for different incidence directions, polarizations, and observation angles. A spectral-token Transformer trained on 50{,}000 irregular particles at 1064~nm maps the morphology spectrum directly to the T-matrix. The predicted operators recover modal structure and reproduce full-angle differential scattering maps and incidence-angle scans. Generalization to out-of-distribution synthetic shapes and natural sand-particle morphologies shows that the dual spectral architecture learns an intrinsic relation from the geometry spectrum to multipolar scattering. This establishes spectral-domain operator learning as a compact route for reusable, angle- and polarization-resolved optical scattering prediction of complex 3D particles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：neural scattering model（神经网络散射模型）、spectral-domain deep learning（谱域深度学习）、T-matrix（T矩阵）。；研究对象：任意形状的紧凑三维粒子的光学散射现象，具体包括不规则合成形状和天然沙粒形态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种双谱域神经网络散射模型，能够将粒子几何形态（用球谐系数表示）直接映射到其T矩阵（用球矢量波基表示），从而实现对任意形状三维粒子全角度、偏振分辨的光学散射快速预测，并泛化到训练集之外的形态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种双谱域神经网络散射模型，能够将粒子几何形态（用球谐系数表示）直接映射到其T矩阵（用球矢量波基表示），从而实现对任意形状三维粒子全角度、偏振分辨的光学散射快速预测，并泛化到训练集之外的形态。；创新点：用双谱域架构（球谐形态谱 + 球矢量波T矩阵）替代传统高维欧几里得几何表示（如体素网格、点云或网格），实现了从几何谱到多极散射的内在关系学习，为可复用的角度和偏振分辨散射预测提供了紧凑路线。
papers.method_zh: 采用谱域深度学习方法：用256个球谐系数压缩表示粒子几何形态，用复T矩阵在球矢量波基中编码光学响应；训练一个基于谱标记（spectral-token）的Transformer模型，在1064 nm波长下对50,000个不规则粒子的形态谱到T矩阵进行映射学习。

papers.title: Spectral Signatures of Replica Symmetry Breaking in Optimization-Induced Random Matrices
papers.abstract: We study optimization-induced matrix ensembles generated by Gibbs measures. The same quenched disorder that weights configurations also supplies the matrix entries observed on them. For glassy Gibbs measures this raises a natural question: does the induced spectrum inherit the underlying glassy Gibbs geometry? In a dense tensor optimization model we find a selective answer. A single induced matrix has a universal leading bulk that washes out the glassy organization. The difference of two matrices built from independent thermal samples in the same disorder does not: its spectrum gives an explicit image of the glassy Gibbs geometry, encoded by the distribution of mutual overlaps between samples. Parisi theory and Monte Carlo confirm this mechanism across simple and glassy phases.

papers.title: Surface Variables Description of Axion Topological Materials
papers.abstract: We study the response of axion topological materials under the presence of external static electric and magnetic fields. We focus on the macroscopic quasi-static magnetoelectric response of topological insulators. We use techniques based on surface variables that have been previously employed in soft condensed matter problems for the description of heterogeneous systems composed of multiple homogeneous materials. A complete description of the whole system is written in terms of surface degrees of freedom, which in this case correspond to effective surface charge and surface current densities. We obtain a set of integral equations satisfied by these variables. We present exact analytic solutions for axial-symmetric cases. We develop a numerical method for the solution of the integral equations by means of a boundary finite element method. We apply the numerical method to topological insulators with different geometries such as spheres, hollow spheres and toroidal surfaces. We show that that a variational principle can be used to recover the surface variables equations.

papers.title: Kinetic magnetism and stripe order in the antiferromagnetic bosonic $t\text{−}J$ model
papers.abstract: Author(s): Timothy J. Harris, Ulrich Schollwöck, Annabelle Bohrdt, and Fabian Grusdt How can particle statistics influence the competition between charge motion and magnetic order in doped antiferromagnets? Here, the authors use large-scale numerical calculations to establish the T=0 phase diagram of the 2D antiferromagnetic bosonic t-J model. They show that mobile bosonic holes stabilize partially filled stripes at low doping, akin to those in high-Tc cuprate superconductors, and drive transitions to polarized ferromagnetic phases via Nagaoka polaron formation. These predictions provide clear targets for future experiments in ultracold-atom quantum simulators.

papers.title: Limited propagation of Pb-Pb interactions through graphene and Pb film growth for Pb/graphene/Pb/SiC intercalation systems
papers.abstract: The growth of epitaxial thin films is directed by the substrate. Here, the authors investigate Pb film growth on SiC-supported graphene with an intercalated Pb(111)-like layer under graphene. They find that Pb–Pb interactions propagate only weakly through graphene, and that the potential energy surface for Pb adatoms does not inherit the periodicity of the intercalated Pb layer. Thus, the intercalated Pb(111) does not “remotely” direct the formation of a Pb(111) film. Nevertheless, the intercalated and on-top Pb(111)-like layers are in-registry reflecting their interaction with the same graphene sheet.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：investigate、growth、find、intercalation systems。；研究对象：Pb/石墨烯/Pb/SiC插层体系中Pb薄膜的外延生长，以及石墨烯对Pb-Pb相互作用的屏蔽效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Pb原子之间的相互作用通过石墨烯仅能微弱传播，且Pb吸附原子的势能面并不继承插层Pb(111)层的周期性，因此插层Pb(111)层无法“远程”引导上层Pb(111)薄膜的形成。但插层与顶层Pb(111)类层仍保持晶格匹配，反映它们与同一石墨烯层的相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Pb原子之间的相互作用通过石墨烯仅能微弱传播，且Pb吸附原子的势能面并不继承插层Pb(111)层的周期性，因此插层Pb(111)层无法“远程”引导上层Pb(111)薄膜的形成。但插层与顶层Pb(111)类层仍保持晶格匹配，反映它们与同一石墨烯层的相互作用。；创新点：揭示了石墨烯对金属-金属相互作用的强屏蔽效应，证明插层金属层无法通过石墨烯远程控制上层金属薄膜的外延取向，挑战了传统外延生长中“衬底通过界面传递周期性”的假设。

papers.title: Mott-Anderson crossover without metallization in pressurized $\mathrm{S}{\mathrm{r}}_{3}\mathrm{I}{\mathrm{r}}_{2}{\mathrm{O}}_{7}$
papers.abstract: Author(s): Xia Yin, Weicheng Guo, Miao Li, Chunlei Yang, Chengyu Li, Dong Wang, Jianbo Zhang, Yongjin Chen, Takeshi Nakagawa, Caoshun Zhang, Chunsheng Xia, Pengfei Shan, Xiaoping Yang, Sheng Meng, Jun Chang, Ho-kwang Mao, and Yang Ding Here, the authors use high-pressure transport, low-temperature magnetoresistance, x-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy to show that Sr3Ir2O7 evolves, without metallization, from a Mott regime dominated by electronic correlations to an Anderson-like localized regime dominated by disorder. Pressure collapses the activation gap near 12–17 GPa, yet low-temperature conduction remains nonmetallic and follows three-dimensional variable-range hopping, highlighting how localization can preempt metallization in bandwidth-tuned correlated materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“high-pressure transport, low-temperature magnetoresistance, x-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy”等实验手段。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是层状钙钛矿氧化物 Sr₃Ir₂O₇。研究的物理现象是压力调控下，该材料中电子关联（Mott 物理）与无序诱导的局域化（Anderson 物理）之间的竞争与交叉（crossover），以及金属化被抑制的机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在压力作用下，Sr₃Ir₂O₇ 并未发生金属化，而是从电子关联主导的 Mott 绝缘体态，直接交叉到无序诱导的 Anderson 局域态。压力虽然关闭了激活能隙，但低温电导仍表现为非金属性的三维变程跳跃（3D-VRH）行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在压力作用下，Sr₃Ir₂O₇ 并未发生金属化，而是从电子关联主导的 Mott 绝缘体态，直接交叉到无序诱导的 Anderson 局域态。压力虽然关闭了激活能隙，但低温电导仍表现为非金属性的三维变程跳跃（3D-VRH）行为。；创新点：该工作揭示了在带宽调控的强关联材料中，无序诱导的局域化可以“抢先”于预期的金属化（Mott 转变）发生，从而阻止金属态的出现。这为理解关联与无序的相互作用提供了新的实验范例。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：高压输运测量、低温磁电阻测量、X射线衍射（XRD）以及透射电子显微镜（TEM）。

papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“introduce an entanglement witness”（引入纠缠见证）、“analyzing the particle-hole reduced density matrices”（分析粒子-空穴约化密度矩阵），属于理论框架的构建。；研究对象：混合粒子量子系统，即同时包含费米子和玻色子的量子多体系统。具体关注的物理现象是离域长程序（ODLRO），这是一种特殊的纠缠形式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作提出了一种新的纠缠见证，能够识别混合费米-玻色子系统中的离域长程序（ODLRO）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作提出了一种新的纠缠见证，能够识别混合费米-玻色子系统中的离域长程序（ODLRO）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据摘要内容，其创新点在于将ODLRO的纠缠见证从纯费米子或纯玻色子系统推广到了混合粒子系统，并实现了对每个子系统的独立检测。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析每个子系统（费米子子系统与玻色子系统）的粒子-空穴约化密度矩阵，来独立地检测ODLRO的存在。这是一个纯粹的理论分析方法。
